title: Sports Performance
desc: If your goal is to become faster, stronger, quicker, and more athletic, this is where the work gets done.

details.tagline: Speed wins games. Strength creates advantages. Performance separates athletes.
details.body:
Our Thursday & Friday Night Sports Performance program is built for athletes who want more than just skill training. Through expert-led strength, speed, and agility development, athletes will enhance their physical performance and gain the tools needed to compete at the highest level.

## Athletes will focus on

- Explosive acceleration and speed
- Power and strength development
- Quickness and agility training
- Athletic movement mechanics
- Injury resilience and recovery
